candidates.name: Necrobiotic xanthogranuloma
support_spans: Dense diffuse cellular infiltrate composed mainly of foamy histiocytic cells and multinucleated Touton cells mixed with lymphocytes and eosinophils.
Positive for CD68 and CD163, but negative for S100, CD1a, and Langerin.
candidates.why: The presence of foamy histiocytic cells, Touton cells, and specific immunohistochemical staining patterns support this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Juvenile xanthogranuloma
support_spans: Multiple yellow to reddish brown firm papules and nodules were present on the scalp, face, neck, trunk, and limbs, including the axillae and inguinal regions.
Dense diffuse cellular infiltrate composed mainly of foamy histiocytic cells and multinucleated Touton cells mixed with lymphocytes and eosinophils.
candidates.why: The clinical presentation of yellow to reddish brown papules and nodules, along with the histopathological findings, is consistent with this diagnosis.
